authorization_basis: User explicitly authorized the corrected payload after the terminal pre-oracle worker image failure.
modal_source_upload_note: Implied by the owner's explicit launch authorization: the run executes on Modal, so launching it necessarily uploads the pinned source. Recorded explicitly rather than inherited silently from the v1 receipt.
reason_for_new_payload: The previous 3x250 payload 2e3f9195... ran to completion, but its gsk3b task is VOID: the worker restored the working directory after CONSTRUCTING the TDC oracle, while PyTDC loads oracle/gsk3b_current.pkl lazily on the first CALL by relative path, so all 250 charged calls returned the swallowed default_property 0.0 (diagnostics/pmo_gsk3b_oracle_diagnosis_v1.json, diagnostics/pmo_run_status_ledger.json).  This payload binds a worker that resolves asset-backed oracles for the oracle's full lifetime via AssetPinnedOracle, and that refuses to charge a single call until a pinned positive control CALLS the oracle and reproduces the frozen reference panel.  perindopril_mpo (0.486) and celecoxib_rediscovery (0.196) from the previous payload are unaffected and remain valid; only gsk3b is re-run.
